key_changes.paired_policy_comparison: PairedPolicyComparison canonical type standardizes statistical comparison results with point_delta, lcb95, ucb95, positive_group_fraction, worst_group_delta, estimand, and to_dict().
key_changes.bootstrap_estimand: paired_group_bootstrap supports task_weighted (default) and group_equal_weight estimands.
key_changes.dataset_leakage_fix: generate_b5_dataset implements global prompt deduplication. template_group_id added to B5TaskSpec.
key_changes.surface_feature_extractor: Consistent surface feature extraction across splits (subtype one-hot, TF-IDF vocabulary).
key_changes.api_key_removal: Fake API keys removed from configs. check_api_key_placeholder validator added.
key_changes.b4_legacy_stats_removal: Inline statistical calculations in run_b4_staged.py replaced with canonical stats.py functions.
key_changes.b4_invalidation: Corrupt B4 evidence moved to artifacts/invalidated/ with invalidation.json.
key_changes.artifact_scanner: Repo-wide test rejecting zero hashes, placeholder hashes, SSH/PTY corruption, and fake API keys.
key_changes.positive_negative_controls: Synthetic pipeline supports control_mode positive (qualifies) and negative (fails). Infrastructure validity separated from scientific qualification.
key_changes.error_semantics: Frozen ExecutionStatus enum with utility rules. ObservedCost dataclass. compute_observed_utility implements U = w_A * A - C - w_F * F.
key_changes.b5_diagnostics: Empirical crossover analysis, THINK-FAST delta analysis, compute budget frontier.
key_changes.b5_staged_runner: Canonical real-model experiment entrypoint with prepare/counterfactuals/representations/train/qualify/reproduce stages and resume safety.
key_changes.failed_leakage_reproduction: FAILED_LEAKAGE and FAILED_REPRODUCTION lifecycle statuses added.
key_changes.reproduction_hardening: reproduce.py verifies config hash. Tests for corruption, missing files, config changes, hash mismatches.
